meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: Claude 仍是主控,但能把任务交给本机 Ollama 跑的本地模型:列出已装模型、向指定模型发提示词并取回回答;开启可选开关后,还能拉取、删除、查看模型,以及查看内存中已加载的模型。
howto.when: 当你要给容器里的 agent 接入本机 Ollama 模型、按步骤改代码并配置时使用;装好后当你要求用 ollama 生成回答也会触发。前提是 Ollama 守护进程可访问。

say.text: 用 ollama 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
把 gemma3:1b 模型拉取下来
哪些 ollama 模型现在加载在内存里?

howto.what_en: Claude stays the orchestrator but can hand work to local Ollama models: list installed models and send a prompt to a chosen model for a response. An opt-in flag also adds tools to pull, delete, show, and list running models.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want the container agent to call local Ollama models and are setting it up; after install, it triggers when you ask it to use ollama to answer. Requires the Ollama daemon reachable.

say_en.text: Use ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude lists models, then calls ollama_generate.

say_en.text: Which ollama models are loaded in memory?
